_comment: Copy to C:\AI\config\models.json and edit for the models YOU chose (docs/INSTALL-MODELS.md). Paths are relative to C:\AI\image-models. Profile keys are what the page refers to; the page currently knows these keys: turbo, quality, real, max, turbo21, edit, video. Use the ones you need and remove the rest. recipe = the sd-server recipe name for that model family (see stable-diffusion.cpp docs).
